hero.title: A space built for curiosity
hero.subtitle: Every corner of The Trium School campus is designed to inspire learning, creativity, and growth.

intro.heading: Where learning comes alive
intro.body: Nestled in the serene surroundings of Makhmalabad, Nashik, our campus blends thoughtful architecture with nature to create an environment where children thrive. From state-of-the-art labs to open green spaces, every facility is purpose-built for holistic development.

facilities.name: Smart Classrooms
facilities.description: Bright, airy classrooms equipped with interactive smart boards and flexible seating that adapts to collaborative and individual learning.

facilities.name: Science Laboratories
facilities.description: Fully equipped science labs where students conduct hands-on experiments from primary school onwards, building scientific curiosity early.
facilities.image_slot: media/Young Scientists Exploring a Colourful Lab.png

facilities.name: STEM & Robotics Studio
facilities.description: A dedicated maker space with robotics kits, coding stations, and 3D printing tools — where ideas become prototypes.

facilities.name: Library & Reading Room
facilities.description: A curated library of over 5,000 titles spanning fiction, non-fiction, and reference — a quiet haven for readers and researchers alike.
facilities.image_slot: media/Brighter Minds in the School Library.png

facilities.name: Sports Grounds
facilities.description: Expansive outdoor grounds for cricket, football, athletics, and more — supporting physical fitness and team spirit.

facilities.name: Performing Arts Centre
facilities.description: A dedicated stage and rehearsal space for drama, music, and dance — nurturing every child's creative voice.
facilities.image_slot: media/Creative Arts Rehearsal at Trium School.png

cta.heading: See it for yourself
cta.body:
